selector.rationale: Evidence of needle-shaped clefts within the lumen of a blood vessel and eccrine ducts with cellular dyshesion and necrosis supports atheroembolism, which is also consistent with the patient's history of severe peripheral arterial disease and previous vascular interventions.

rejected.label: Vasculitis
rejected.why: Contradicted by lack of significant perivascular inflammation and normal peripheral eosinophil count

rejected.label: Atherosclerotic embolism
rejected.why: Less specific and lower score compared to atheroembolism

rejected.label: Cholesterol crystal embolization
rejected.why: Similar to cholesterol crystal embolism but with a lower score and less comprehensive evidence
